title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — Canonical Error Examples
description: Example error payloads for the Origin Layer (0D) of the TriadicFrameworks MCP cosmology.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

interpretation.technical: The authentication payload is missing the required 'token' field.
interpretation.mythic: The observer approaches the gate without a name; the origin layer cannot open.

interpretation.technical: The token expiration timestamp is earlier than the current validation time.
interpretation.mythic: The signal has faded; the origin layer no longer hears the observer.

error.message: Token clientId does not match payload clientId.

interpretation.technical: The token was issued to a different clientId.
interpretation.mythic: The identity is fractured; the origin layer rejects the mismatched signal.

interpretation.technical: The discovery system cannot locate the requested tool.
interpretation.mythic: The origin layer searches the universe but finds no such instrument.

interpretation.technical: Search requires a non-empty query string.
interpretation.mythic: The origin layer cannot respond to silence; the observer must speak a name.

interpretation.technical: The input type does not match the schema.
interpretation.mythic: The origin layer rejects a blurred signal; clarity is required.
